-- Tem Shop, [i]Undertale[/i] (Toby Fox)

In the spirit of the Temmie Armor from Undertale, this replaces the Sneakers item with Temmie Boots, which have 30 defense and 30 immunity (for reference, the Space Boots are the highest-ranked footwear in the game, and they have 4 defense and 4 immunity). This means that you take a [i]lot[/i] less damage from enemies.

Goes well with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9711]Annoying Dog Skin[/url]! And while you're at it, I [i]guess[/i] you could also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3534]turn the Dwarf into Sans[/url]...

[b]To install[/b]:
1. Install [url=http://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] using the instructions on that website.
2. If you don't already have it, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] by unzipping it and putting it into the Mods folder.
3. Unzip this one and put it into the Mods folder, alongside Content Patcher.

[b]Multiplayer compatibility[/b]: It should be fine to use these in a multiplayer game, but everyone else will only see you as having sneakers.
